lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill region. The spots are arranged in a semi-regular grid, with inter-spot distance increasing along the longitudinal axis towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of spots, forming distinct anchor nodes particularly in the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a highlighted superior edge to a shadowed inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of minute, low-contrast spots is visible on the anterior region preceding the first gill slit.
